applicableAreas: Southern and eastern property boundaries (overhead electric lines)
findings.comment: Austin Energy electrical infrastructure shown on Preliminary Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) is not depicted on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). Sheet 21 shows 4 transformer pads, underground electric lines routed under drive aisles and sidewalks, electrical pull boxes, and overhead electric lines. Sheet 31 shows no transformer locations, no underground routing, and only the overhead electric line along the southern boundary. The absence of electrical facilities on the landscape plan prevents landscape contractors and reviewers from verifying clearance compliance and avoiding utility conflicts during construction and maintenance. Add all electrical transformer pad locations, underground conduit routing, pull box locations, and overhead line locations to landscape plan with appropriate clearance callouts.

applicableAreas: Throughout site within electric easement areas
findings.comment: Mitigation trees are proposed adjacent to 5' electric easements along the southern and eastern property boundaries (identified on Grading Plan Sheet 11). Landscape Plan shows no documentation of required license agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement. No plan note or reference states agreement has been obtained. Verify and provide executed License Agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement before certificate of occupancy, or add plan note stating 'License Agreement obtained from Austin Energy Public Involvement [date]' with agreement attached.

applicableAreas: Trees and shrubs proposed near electrical facilities throughout site
findings.comment: No written Austin Energy approval documentation is visible in submitted plans for any variations from clearance distances or species requirements. Required documentation includes approval letter/email, plan note signed/stamped by Austin Energy, or Austin Energy Design plan stamp with specific approval notation. Provide explicit written approval from Austin Energy for any landscaping within restricted zones or with non-utility-compatible species, or revise design to comply with base UCM standards without variations.

Four transformer pads are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) but their locations are not transferred to Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). Trees and shrubs cannot be verified as maintaining minimum 10-foot clearance from pad-mounted transformers without electrical facilities shown on landscape plan. Overlay electrical transformer pad locations on landscape plan with 10-foot clearance radius circles; verify no trees within access door side clearance and adjust planting as necessary.

Underground electric lines are shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) routed under drive aisles and sidewalks, but this routing is not depicted on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). Trees proposed in drive aisle and sidewalk areas cannot be verified as maintaining proper distance from underground equipment (no trees 0-5 ft, only utility-compatible trees with root barriers 5-20 ft). Overlay underground electric routing on landscape plan; verify tree locations; if trees are within 5-20 ft zone, provide root barrier details (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment edge).
